caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile object, possibly a pouch or bag, oriented vertically with a flap folding down from the top. The object is rendered with colored pencils or watercolors on a neutral, cream-colored background. The textile’s surface features elaborate linear and geometric designs, predominantly in faded reds, greens, blues, and yellows, with the colors arranged in repeating patterns of diamonds, zigzags, and elongated ovals. The edges of the object are outlined in blue and accented with faint purples. The flap at the top shows additional decorative elements, including a row of shapes resembling elongated loops or tassels. The fabric appears worn in places with some parts shaded darker than others to indicate depth or creasing. The background paper shows discoloration and circular stains, especially to the left and above the main object, and the entire composition is centered on the page.
title: Bag
